name: Cross-domain integration
rules: Cross-domain dependencies are concentrated under src/domain/integration.
Events are created but never published.
Event id, sequence and tick are supplied by the caller.
Reward grants use preflight before any mutation.
Rejected reward grants leave currency accounts and inventory unchanged.
Interaction authorization executes no concrete interaction action.
Status effect time integration never prunes terminal effects implicitly.
Progression unlock integration never adds XP.
Stage 63 general snapshot/restore framework is not anticipated.
validationNotes: Condition comparison tests use the canonical ComparisonOperator value 'equals'.
Layer 2 strict TypeScript compile through Stage 62 passed.
Cross-domain test sources type-check with the canonical comparison operator.
Runtime smoke covering all Stage 62 integration paths passed.
